verdict.rationale: Extensive first-party docs confirm a single unified API (OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint) to access hundreds of models across many providers, with model/provider switching via minimal code changes, provider routing controls, and BYOK support, and this is corroborated by probes confirming live docs/OpenAPI endpoints. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of seamless multi-provider switching in production beyond docs/probes.
